options: tan θ = h/a and tan(90-θ) = cot θ = h/b. tan θ * cot θ = (h/a)*(h/b) = 1 => h^2/(ab) = 1 => h = √(ab).
explanation: tan θ = h/a and tan(90-θ) = cot θ = h/b. tan θ * cot θ = (h/a)*(h/b) = 1 => h^2/(ab) = 1 => h = √(ab).

question: As observed from top of 75 m lighthouse, angles of depression of two ships are 30° and 45°. Find distance between ships.
options: Ship 1 at 45°: tan 45° = 75/x => x = 75 m. Ship 2 at 30°: tan 30° = 75/y => y = 75√3 m. Distance = y - x = 75(√3 - 1) m
